verdicts.reason: A does turn the design into a left-to-right banner, but the hierarchy is inverted: the headline 'JOIN OUR CHOIR!' is shrunk to tiny type while the secondary line 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!' is the biggest element. The white cloud graphic sits detached on the white background, so it reads as stray outline debris rather than the brand shape. B is just the original shrunk into the middle of the banner, with huge dead areas on both sides, and 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!' is so small it can't be read, so B fails the fit-to-format and readability criteria outright.
